Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.8.5 · Prepared November 5, 2026

Your class.
Your next move.

More class choices, right where you roll. Clerics protect and heal from the card. Bards share Inspiration, channel spirits and step through moonlight. Wizards bring their subclass benefits into casting and reactions.

Initiative gets the same attention: open its native configuration from Carousel and choose Uncanny Metabolism when your Monk needs Focus.

Release status: v0.8.5 is packaged and verified locally. The module release has not been published to GitHub yet.

v0.8.5 · Cleric: protect, heal, follow through

Cleric: protect, heal, follow through

Make the choice on the roll that needs it, with supported resources and reactions tracked for you.

  • Life: Blessed Healer restores the Cleric’s HP after healing another creature. Disciple of Life and Supreme Healing join the healing roll; Preserve Life lets you allocate its pool across friendly area targets.
  • Grave: Add Pull of Death in damage configuration, maximize eligible healing for creatures at 0 HP, and use Path to the Grave’s curse and extra damage. Sentinel at Death’s Door pauses eligible damage before application and halves the raw roll before resistance.
  • Arcana and Knowledge: Fortify an eligible friendly spell target, reduce a successful enemy save with Tenacious Spell, or select Manifest Magical Knowledge to replace an eligible spell slot with Channel Divinity.
  • Light, Trickery and War: Warding Flare corrects incoming attacks; Corona of Light brings its attached area and lighting. Invoke Duplicity supplies supported attack advantage, while Guided Strike adds its bonus directly to a missed attack.

v0.8.5 · Bard: Inspiration and more

Bard: Inspiration and more

Keep Inspiration’s existing roll controls and add the rest of the supported class and subclass tools.

  • Base class: Font of Inspiration enables Short Rest recovery. Countercharm helps eligible friendly failed Charm/Fear saves, Superior Inspiration recovers uses on initiative, and Words of Creation validates its extra target before spending resources.
  • Dance, Glamour and Lore: Choose Tandem Footwork while rolling initiative; extend Leading Evasion nearby. Mantle of Majesty handles its free Bonus Action Command and concentration, while Peerless Skill helps confirmed failures with a recorded DC or AC.
  • Spirits: Gather separate spirit copies when giving Inspiration, then choose Unleash Spirit or Controlled Channeling. Empowered Channeling adds its supported roll benefit and modified Spirit Guardians half cover.
  • Moon: Inspired Eclipse adds invisibility and click-to-place teleportation without spending movement. Eventide extends the option to the Inspiration recipient. Lunar Vitality offers Yes / No / Free, combining its healing bonus with the recipient’s Speed buff.
  • Blessing of Moonlight: Modify that casting of Moonbeam, gain dim light, and heal once for each failed save. Two failures can grant two independent heals. Its 2d4 healing also supports Lunar Vitality.

v0.8.5 · Wizard: bring the subclass into the spell

Wizard: bring the subclass into the spell

Go beyond spellbook casting with supported school and subclass workflows.

  • Evoker and Abjurer: Sculpt Spells, Potent Cantrip, Empowered Evocation and Overchannel join spell resolution. Arcane Ward and Projected Ward track absorption and Undo; Spell Resistance keeps native mitigation and save-mode cancellation.
  • Bladesinger and Conjurer: Active Bladesong supplies supported weapon benefits and Song of Defense. Durable Summons, Focused Conjuration and Splintered Summons work with summon casting and concentration.
  • Diviner, Enchanter and Illusionist: Roll Portent from its rest reminder, clean up Third Eye benefits on rest, and use supported Hypnotic Presence, Instinctive Charm, Split Enchantment and Illusory Self controls.
  • Necromancer and Transmuter: Supported Undead Vitality, Grave Power, Extinguish Undead, Transmuter’s Stone choices, Empowered Transmutation and Master Transmuter actions use their native feature setup.

Wizard subclass guide →

v0.8.5 · Initiative: choose before you roll

Initiative: choose before you roll

  • Carousel: Enable Override initiative prompt under Rolls & Damage / Healing. Its combatant dice open the native initiative window for Advantage, Normal, Disadvantage, modifiers, roll visibility and supported feature choices. Disable it to restore Carousel’s fast roll.
  • Uncanny Metabolism: Check the option when available. After initiative, the native feature card restores Focus, spends its Long Rest use and automatically rolls/applies the Monk’s self-healing. Canceling initiative spends nothing.
  • Fewer repeated lookups: Shared message indexes and startup discovery reduce repeated traversal in supported workflows. These changes have work-count tests; they are not a measured frame-rate claim.
  • Mirror Image: Resolve duplicates from the attack workflow before damage applies. A successful interception removes a duplicate and changes that attack to a miss.
v0.8.5 · Updating and compatibility

Updating and compatibility

Prepared, not yet published: the v0.8.5 module ZIP is ready locally. This page does not provide an unpublished GitHub download link.

Once the module release is published, install it, restart Foundry and refresh all GM and player clients. Keep an active GM connected for shared resource, effect and HP operations. Test changed behavior with fresh casts and initiative rolls.

  • Foundry VTT 14; D&D5e 6.0.5 minimum, verified with 6.0.6.
  • Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice remain required. Carousel is optional.
  • Matching official source items, activities and effects are needed. Book content is not included; imported or custom items may need adjustments.
  • Supported automation does not cover every class rule. Command’s actual instruction, situational movement, narrative outcomes and the limits listed in the class guide remain table-managed.
  • Release preparation passed 354 local regression test files and syntax checks for 304 runtime JavaScript files. Selected development checks were user-tested; a complete new in-game release play-through was not performed.
